why_ai: Hands-on garment work by a master tailor's eye; no licence needed.

why_digital: Physical garments altered by hand and dropped off at a local shop.

why_digital: In-person fittings and hand construction at a local bridal shop.

why_digital: Measured on the body, cut and sewn by hand, delivered in person.

why_ai: Routine hems and zippers still require hands on physical garments.
